capitalPath.zhCn: IBM 软件工程职业提供编程能力与工资基础
capitalPath.en: IBM software engineering supplied coding skill and conventional income

capitalPath.zhCn: 2013年快速改造开源代码，完成 Dogecoin 初始客户端
capitalPath.en: Rapidly adapted open-source code into Dogecoin's initial client in 2013

capitalPath.zhCn: 约2015年失业后处置大部分加密资产；未保留可验证的巨额创始人财富
capitalPath.en: Disposed of most crypto after losing his job around 2015; no verifiable giant founder fortune was retained

finding.zhCn: 没有 ICO 或公开大额预留
finding.en: No ICO or disclosed large reserve

finding.zhCn: 2021年称仅持有后来收到的小费；当前余额未知
finding.en: In 2021 he said he only held later tips; current balance is unknown

finding.zhCn: 退出后不拥有协议或基金会控制权
finding.en: After leaving, he does not own the protocol or control the Foundation

claim.zhCn: 实现初始 Dogecoin 客户端

finding.zhCn: 本人公开信、代码历史和开发者资料相互支持
finding.en: Supported by his open letter, code history, and developer documentation

finding.zhCn: 不支持；本人称早期资产仅换得二手车量级资金
finding.en: Unsupported; he said early holdings yielded roughly used-car money

finding.zhCn: 错误；他已退出开发，网络由独立参与者运行
finding.en: Incorrect; he left development and independent participants run the network

openQuestions.zhCn: 早期实际挖矿、赠与和出售数量是多少？
openQuestions.en: How much was actually mined, gifted, and sold early on?

openQuestions.zhCn: 退出后各类收入与当前资产构成如何？
openQuestions.en: What income and assets followed his exit?

summary.zhCn: 建立创建贡献、退出和未形成巨额创始人储备的证据边界。
summary.en: Established evidence boundaries around implementation, exit, and the absence of a giant founder reserve.
